anchors_at_b1_entry.cipher_vllm_plugin_md5: b89a9b6e (reinstalled in vllm_env per Anil Item 5)

seven_step_results.mechanism_finding: vllm_env virtualenv sys.path does NOT include /usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/; system Python's sys.path DOES. importlib.metadata only discovers entry points in dirs on sys.path.

diagnostic_evidence.verdict: Standard dist-info entry-point registration mechanism WORKS for system Python (Q6 (a) mechanism is sound); FAILS for virtualenv-isolated Python because virtualenvs do not include /usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/ in their sys.path. Goal 5 deployment target needs adjudication: does the customer run vLLM under system Python or under a virtualenv?

branch_verdict: Branch C per V1_PHASE_B_SCOPE_LOCK.md §8: POC reveals minor mechanism wrinkle (virtualenv sys.path scope). Standard dist-info works for system Python (Q6 (a) mechanism sound); virtualenv-isolated Python needs additional path manipulation. Scope-lock amendment surface to Anil with five options below before B.2.

five_options_surfaced_for_anil.option_1_system_python_only: v2.0 .deb targets /usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/ (system Python only). Customers running vLLM under system Python (no virtualenv) get plugin discovery automatically. Customers using virtualenv (recommended ML practice) need to install plugin into their virtualenv separately. Goal 5 contract narrows: 'system Python deployment' becomes a documented v1 constraint.
five_options_surfaced_for_anil.option_2_dual_path: v2.0 .deb installs into BOTH /usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/ (system Python) AND a documented virtualenv path (e.g., /usr/local/share/cipher/plugin/) with a .pth file mechanism customer activates in their virtualenv. Adds a Step 3 to the customer recipe (one .pth file copy).
five_options_surfaced_for_anil.option_3_post_install_detect_venvs: v2.0 .deb post-install hook detects active/named virtualenvs (e.g., common vllm_env at /home/*/vllm_env, /opt/*/vllm-*) and installs plugin into each. Heuristic; fragile across customer environments.
five_options_surfaced_for_anil.option_4_documented_virtualenv_setup: v2.0 .deb ships a single virtualenv-activation script (e.g., /usr/lib/cipher/activate-in-venv.sh) that the customer runs once per virtualenv to register plugin. Adds a one-time setup step per virtualenv to the customer recipe.
five_options_surfaced_for_anil.option_5_pth_file_in_system_path: v2.0 .deb installs a .pth file in /usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/ that, when sourced (which happens via sitecustomize.py for system Python), adds /usr/lib/cipher/python/ to sys.path. Combined with plugin files at /usr/lib/cipher/python/, system Python works. Does NOT help virtualenvs (they have their own site.py initialization).

honest_residue: 1. The R-B.1 POC validated the Q6 (a) standard dist-info mechanism is SOUND. The unexpected wrinkle is that /usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/ is system-Python-specific.

2. Goal 5 deployment target adjudication needed: production neoclouds may run vLLM under system Python OR under virtualenv. Need to verify which is the realistic v1 deployment target before B.2 commits to a mechanism.

3. cipher_vllm_kv plugin at md5 b89a9b6e currently lives only at /home/ubuntu/cipher_vllm_plugin/ which is added to system Python sys.path (per verification above) when pip install -e was run there. This is why cipher_vllm_kv works today: the pip install -e adds an editable-install path entry. Under vllm_env, pip install -e adds it to vllm_env's site-packages instead. The current packaging investigation surfaces the same scope question for v2.0 .deb.
4. The 5 options above are not exhaustive; Anil may identify a 6th. NO AUTO SCOPE-DEGRADE: surfacing for adjudication, not picking unilaterally.
5. The cleanup after diagnostic re-install (apt remove cipher-rb1-poc) succeeded; system state is clean post-POC.
